title: How Coronary Angioplasty and Stent Placement Work | PCI Explained
description:
What happens after an angiogram finds a narrowed coronary artery? Video 3 of Elysian Biomedical LLP’s Cardiology Education Series follows one example of coronary angioplasty and stent placement, from the guide catheter and wire to balloon preparation, stent expansion, a final contrast check, and recovery.

For general education. Your care team can explain the treatment, medicines, and recovery plan that apply to you. Original educational animation with simulated angiograms and synthetic English narration.

title: How Coronary Drug-Coated Balloons Work | In-Stent Restenosis
description:
How can a coronary artery narrow again after a stent, and what does a drug-coated balloon do? Video 4 of Elysian Biomedical LLP’s Cardiology Education Series follows a selected in-stent restenosis example from imaging and preparation to balloon treatment, the final contrast check, and recovery.

For general education. Approved uses vary by country and device. Your care team can explain the treatment, medicines, and recovery plan that apply to you. Original educational animation with simulated angiograms and synthetic English narration.
